schemaVersion.description: BN-a (BeakSight block noise design 3.1, item 5): page-schema/1.1 has the marks of the BeakSight blocks (the phase and resource type of the stopped events, the requests stopped while closing, the network failure marks, and the load of each safety evidence). LG-4: a page.json of page-schema/1.0 (without the marks) and a checkpoint holding one are no longer read.
schemaVersion.$comment: REC-3: page-schema/2.0 is the form on the disk (page.json and the result of a checkpoint page): the layout and accessibility Evidence repeat less (layoutEvidenceRecord, accessibilityRuleRecord, factoredList, sameAsRef, recheckBase). page-schema/1.1 is the form in memory. A checkpoint page of the earlier version is not read.

documentRequests.description: Optional (DEF-129): the main frame document requests that the Guard sent in the context of the viewport (the load of BeakSight, the redirects and the loads started by the page).

childFrameDocumentRequests.description: Optional (T37R2-fix): the child frame document requests that the Guard sent in the context of the viewport (a separate count).

subresourceRequests.description: Optional (DEF-130-fix): the requests other than documents (images, fetch, xhr and so on) that the Guard sent in the context of the viewport (a separate count).

stateId.description: Optional (AUD-2a): the state ID of the load of the viewport (<pageId>:<viewport>:<attempt>). The Evidence of the load has the same value in capture.stateId.

settling.description: Optional (AUD-2a): the result of the settling (page-settling with the progress watch). Absent when the settling stage did not start.

loadPhases.description: Optional (AUD-2b): the transitions of the load phase (only when it changed; the first is AFTER_DOM_CONTENT_LOADED).

recheck.description: Optional (AUD-2d): the recheck after the page settled (no reload). The marks of the findings (by fingerprint) and of the headings: PERSISTENT, INITIAL_ONLY or LATE.

pageReady.description: Optional (EV-3): whether the page was ready (no visible loading indicator) when the recheck read it again. Only when RECHECKED.

notificationHandling.description: Optional (AUD-2a): the handling of the notification frames of the main load (the dismissed and hidden counts and the digests of the frames). Absent when the stage did not start.

evidenceCapture.description: AUD-2a: the state and the time of the collection of one Evidence (the phase is a page audit stage).

capture.description: Optional (AUD-2a): the state and the time of the collection. Absent on the Evidence of an older run and on the Evidence that does not belong to a viewport load.

recheckBase.description: Optional (REC-3, the form on the disk): the ID of the first Evidence that the rechecked layout or accessibility Evidence refers to with sameAs.

blockedByBeakSight.description: BN-a (BeakSight block noise design 3.1, item 3): whether the failure is a request BeakSight stopped (the error text before truncation, matched with the block failure texts of src/core/blocked-by-client-failures.ts).

clippedToZeroArea.description: Optional (DEF-205): whether clip or clip-path of the element or an ancestor leaves no painted area (visually hidden). Older evidence does not have it.

sameAsRef.description: REC-3 (the form on the disk): an item of a rechecked list that is the same as the item at this index of the same list of the first Evidence (recheckBase).

factoredList.description: REC-3 (the form on the disk): a list whose fields of the same value on every item are written once in common. keys is the order of the fields of an item; an item has the other fields.

layoutEvidenceRecord.description: REC-3: layoutEvidence, or its form on the disk (the lists are factored or refer to the first Evidence, and the elements of the overlaps are indexes into overlapElements).

accessibilityRuleRecord.description: REC-3: accessibilityRule, or its form on the disk (the nodes are factored, or the rule of a rechecked Evidence refers to the first Evidence).

innerScrollContainer.description: Optional (L9, COV-5, AUD-5): one inner scroll container that the controlled scroll traversed, in document order.

blockedEventPhase.description: BN-a (BeakSight block noise design 3.1): when the Guard stopped the event. LOAD: during the load of the Context (for the page audit, before and while measuring). CLOSING: while closing the Context, or after BeakSight began leaving the page before closing it. Required (LG-4: the records without it are no longer read).

blockedResourceType.description: BN-a: the resource type of the stopped request, normalized by the Guard (the closed list of the Guard). Required.

blockedSpeculativeMark.description: BN-R1 M-2: the mark of a speculative (prefetch or prerender) request, whose Sec-Purpose or Purpose header includes prefetch. Present only on such a request.

blockedClosingRequests.description: BN-a (BeakSight block noise design 3.1, item 2): the requests the Guard stopped while closing the Context (the stopping is unchanged; only the record is new). Only when at least one was stopped. count also counts the requests beyond the event limit and the ones whose method and URL could not be read. Not in blockedRequestsByMethod, blockedRequests or the SAFETY findings.

frameClassificationFailures.description: SAFE-2 item 4 (category (3) of the violations; designer's decision): the navigations whose frame kind (main frame or child frame) the Guard could not classify (formerly the violation FRAME_CLASSIFICATION_FAILED). The browser stopped them and nothing went out, so they are not violations and the Context stays open. Only when at least one was recorded. count also counts the events beyond the event limit. Not a SAFETY finding.

readNavigationFailures.description: SAFE-2 item 4 (DEF-145): the failures of the delivery of the main frame navigations that are reads (GET and HEAD) the Guard allowed (formerly the violation HTTP_MAIN_FRAME_DELIVERY_FAILED; a non-read failure is still a violation). Whether the read reached the server is unknown, and a read is safe either way. url has the origin and the path only (no query, fragment or value). Only when at least one was recorded. count also counts the events beyond the event limit. Not a SAFETY finding.

safetyEvidenceLoad.description: BN-a (BeakSight block noise design 3.1, item 4): the load of the Ledger of the safety evidence. PAGE_AUDIT: the page audit load (desktop and mobile). STRESS_WIDTH: one width of the width scan (CSS px). INTERACTION: one Interaction candidate (its index in the discovery order, from 0). Required.

passedAuditSendRequests.description: AS-a and AS-b (audit send policy design 2.3): the non-read requests that the Guard let through with the audit send policy PASS_EXCEPT_DELETE (method, origin, path with value-like segments hidden, and count; no query, body or value). Only when at least one was let through.

otherOrigins.description: AS-c: the number of the passed requests to another Origin (neither an allowed Origin nor an approved service Origin). Required (LG-4: the records without it are no longer read).

passedAuditSendWebSockets.description: AS-c (audit send policy design, chapter 5): the WebSocket connections that the Guard let through with the audit send policy PASS_EXCEPT_DELETE (ws/wss origin, path with value-like segments hidden, and count; no query, no message and no value). Only when at least one was let through. AS-c fix round 1: counted from the connections the browser opened (CDP events), with marks for the ones opened without the Guard route and the dangerous ones.

outsideGuard.description: AS-c fix round 1: the mark of the connections opened without the Guard route (a page script bypassed the WebSocket mock, or a Worker).

dangerous.description: AS-c fix round 1: the mark of the connections whose URL hits a dangerous term.

outsideGuard.description: AS-c fix round 1: the number of the connections opened without the Guard route. Required (LG-4).

dangerous.description: AS-c fix round 1: the number of the connections whose URL hits a dangerous term. Required (LG-4).
